DETECT.owns: Inline boot-time detection: health probe failure, port conflict, entry-missing, node-unusable
DETECT.note: Array of attempts collected during startup; feeds startup-report.json

DETECT.owns: Post-boot observation: healthz :5200/:5230, DATABASE_URL, vertical-slice smoke
DETECT.note: Uses legacy ports 5200/5230 from early architecture; first-release uses 3000/4000

DETECT.owns: Desired vs Actual drift: PROCESS_MISSING, PORT_MISSING, BUILD_MISMATCH, etc

CLASSIFY.owns: Domain classification: DOCKER, DATABASE, REDIS_QUEUE, BACKEND_API, DESKTOP, UNKNOWN
Boot blocker description and exit code mapping

ACTION.owns: Recipe-based repair: observe_only, start_control_plane, start_cockpit, leaf_boot_repair
ACTION.note: Uses pnpm sci:repair (shell:true); not adapted for packaged runtime

ACTION.owns: Inline service start/reuse during boot: ProcessSupervisor.start()
Graceful stop all children + Job fallback

VERIFY.note: Legacy ports; needs port alignment for first-release

VERIFY.owns: Health polling after spawn with timeout and exit-code detection

BUDGET.owns: In-memory per-recipe max 2, total max 12 attempt budget
BUDGET.note: Not persistent across runs; no cooldown timer; no circuit breaker

POLICY.owns: Risk-class gating: R0/R1 allowed, R2 conditional, R3+ needs allowR3, R4/R5 denied

UI_REPORTING.owns: Boot-time report: verdict, blockers, recoveryAttempts, warning

BACKUP_ROLLBACK.owns: Atomic swap: stage→verify→promote→backup. Keeps app.backup.<timestamp> and attempts app.backup.last alias
BACKUP_ROLLBACK.technicalDebt: EPERM on app.backup.last when node.exe still held by prior process

convergenceDecision.WHI-010 augments: existing authorities via a host-state-aware recovery-intelligence layer
convergenceDecision.integration: start-sci-os.cjs invokes recovery-intelligence on detected boot/runtime failures; meta-recovery consumes host twin + incident evidence as input
